name: Toucan Interactive Corp.
summary: Toucan Interactive Corp. currently lacks substantial business operations. The firm's primary objective is to identify and acquire a prospective enterprise that aims to become a publicly traded company. In earlier periods, it provided credit intelligence solutions centered on a wide array of banks. These financial institutions were situated across Costa Rica, Canada, and the United States, as well as various other countries throughout North, Central, and South America. The corporation was founded in 2014 and has its headquarters in Arcadia, California.
